tasks.label: publish-iis-sb
args: $site='\\68d-mmslpm\cms'; $flag=Join-Path $site 'maintenance.flag'; $index=Join-Path $site 'wwwroot\index.html'; $indexBak=Join-Path $site 'wwwroot\index.html.bak'; $shutdownAt=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(60).ToUnixTimeMilliseconds(); Set-Content -Path $flag -Value $shutdownAt -Force; Write-Host 'Maintenance countdown active. Waiting 60s for in-flight users...'; Start-Sleep -Seconds 60; Copy-Item '${workspaceFolder}\app_offline.htm' (Join-Path $site 'app_offline.htm') -Force; if (Test-Path $index) { Move-Item $index $indexBak -Force }; Write-Host 'App offline. Publishing...'; try { dotnet publish '${workspaceFolder}\CMS.Server\CMS.Server.csproj' -c Release -o $site } finally { Remove-Item (Join-Path $site 'app_offline.htm') -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item $flag -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (Test-Path $indexBak) { Remove-Item $indexBak -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host 'Done, app back online.' }
